1. The present application is filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 seeking condonation of delay of 08 days in filing the appeal.
2. In view of the reasons mentioned in the application, delay of 08 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.
3. The application stands disposed of.

4. The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to set aside the judgment/award dated 20.11.2023 passed by the court of Sh. Gagandeep Jindal, ADJ-01+MACT,

sentences.text: 5. Issue notice.
6. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no. 1/Union of India, accepts notice.
Ms. Mrinalini Sen, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no. 2/DDA, accepts notice.

7. The counsel for the appellants stated that the connected appeal bearing LA APP. no. 667/2023 titled as Ajit Singh (Deceased) Through LRs V Union of India & Anr. has already been admitted vide order dated 21.12.2023 and the same is now listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
8.
The present appeal is accordingly admitted for hearing.

9. List the present appeal in the category of 'Regular Matters' to be listed in due course along with other connected appeals.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J MARCH 13, 2024 N/ABK
